title: Flatness of a map of thickenings propagates from the reduction when the source is flat finitely presented
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For a morphism (X ⊂ X') -> (Y ⊂ Y') over (B ⊂ B') of thickenings of spaces with Y' -> B' locally of finite type, X' -> B' flat and locally of finite presentation, f flat, and X, Y the scheme-theoretic fibres over B, the lemma concludes f' flat and Y' -> B' flat at every image point of |f'|. The retained proof is the written chart descent: choose the three-stage surjective etale scheme presentation U' -> B', V' -> U' x_{B'} Y', W' -> V' x_{Y'} X' (base changes U, V, W over B); flatness of f' is etale-local on source and target so equivalent to flatness of W' -> V' given flatness of W -> V; the schemes chapter engine (More on Morphisms, lemma flatness-morphism-thickenings-fp-over-ft) applied to the induced diagram of thickenings of schemes yields both conclusions, each transferred back along the presentations. Retained author proof at lines 4267-4288.
